# bioconductor-speckle

## Overview

Use the Bioconductor R package **speckle** for: the package will be updated with new functions.

## Installation

```r
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("speckle")
```
